development_data: 2026-10-12 Kyoto R7-R12 only; not prospective evidence

metadata_inputs.quality_tier_policy: append-only official tier mappings for newly encountered race names; existing baseline mappings may not change during v3.1 holdout

holdout_start_rule: The first eligible Kyoto race whose valid source capture, odds snapshot and pre-result freeze all satisfy the frozen contract after created_at_jst is holdout race 1. Every subsequent eligible Kyoto race must be attempted chronologically and recorded in the attempt ledger until 20 scored FROZEN races are accumulated.
change_control: Any threshold or rescue-logic change creates v3.2 or later and starts a new holdout window.
integrity_note: The frozen snapshot preparer records source-page hashes. The frozen holdout wrapper verifies preparer/classifier/wrapper SHAs, baseline quality tiers, race identity, active horse-number set, eligibility, and the 15-25 minute pre-post market window. Every eligible race is additionally recorded in the attempt ledger as FROZEN or PRE_RESULT_DATA_FAILURE. The formal evaluator requires the scored race sequence to match the first FROZEN attempts and applies p<=0.05, candidate fraction<=0.65, and freeze success rate>=0.80.

formal_evaluation.primary_test: one-sided exact stratified random-addition rescue test

integrity_correction: Corrected the candidate-channel test blob SHA before any holdout race was attempted; no scientific threshold, eligibility, or decision rule changed.
